attacker_owns_two_services.meaning: attacker holds ownership of two staked services (serviceA and serviceB) in the staking contract before the unstake action

attacker_is_unprivileged.meaning: attacker is a plain unprivileged contract requiring no special roles

balance_state_after.meaning: value of the contract balance state variable after the reentrant double-unstake scenario

actual_eth_after.meaning: actual ETH held by the contract (address(this).balance) after the reentrant double-unstake scenario

accounting_discrepancy.meaning: reported accounting discrepancy of 142 mETH representing rewards that should have been tracked but weren't, gained by the attacker

assumptions: The balance state variable and actual ETH are both denominated in mETH as reported.
The reentrant double-unstake scenario is the checked action producing the post-state observables.

unresolved.description: The report states the attacker gains a 142 mETH accounting discrepancy but does not define a numeric relation tying that discrepancy to the balance/actual-ETH difference; the correspondence pattern only encodes balance_state_after == actual_eth_after, so the 142 mETH magnitude is carried only as an impact-context qualifier, not as a derived identity.

limitations: The 142 mETH figure is preserved as an impact-context equality on a dedicated symbol; no report-supported equation links it to the balance/actual-ETH gap.
The single-unstake-per-transaction intent is not the selected intent for this claim; only the balance==actualETH correspondence is formalized.
